environment: Same source media, firmware, release binary and machine as observations.json; new cold boot.
boot_and_welcome: Same frame intervals and welcome button sequence as observations.json.

button_sequence.restore: Own same-build state at verified English hover; run two frames before button.

counter_samples.limit: Samples follow run steps; they do not expose transient counter values within a frame.

native_outcome: The installer advances to instructions to write-protect both master disks and click OK. No work disk or editor boot is verified.
media_provenance_limit: The source image already contains personalisation. Its displayed name is neither transcribed nor published; no claim of pristine factory media is made.
display_observation: Cold-boot live-session captures before any selection button include complete and blank menu states. Snapshot restoration is not necessary to observe a blank capture. No rendering mechanism or regression is established.
private_artifacts: Post-selection personalisation screen, media, snapshots, diagnostic logs and locator paths are excluded.
